Package com.csse3200.game.cards.effects

Class CardResolutionService

java.lang.Object
com.csse3200.game.cards.effects.CardResolutionService
public class CardResolutionService extends Object
Team 3's local stand-in for Team 5's single card-play entry point.

Given a CardPlayRequest it reads the card config from Team 6's library, checks the player's energy, resolves the card's effects through CardEffectResolver, then commits the deck and energy changes and returns a single CardPlayResult. When Team 5 ships their real entry point, this class is the only thing Team 3 needs to swap out.
